# ThemeToggle props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `"light" \| "dark"` | required | Current active theme. |
| `onClick` | `MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Called when the toggle button is clicked. |
| `lightIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom icon shown when the theme is light. |
| `darkIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | Custom icon shown when the theme is dark. |
| `labels` | `Partial<ThemeToggleLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_THEME_TOGGLE_LABELS`. `aria-label` takes precedence. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `switchToDark` | `string` | `"Switch to dark mode"` | Name of the button while the theme is light. |
| `switchToLight` | `string` | `"Switch to light mode"` | Name of the button while the theme is dark. |
